Draft agenda (attached):
1) Introductions & objectives (5m)
2) MAP overview, milestones & owners (15m)
3) Evaluation plan: datasets, success criteria, and roles (20m)
4) Timeline to pilot and decision gates (10m)
5) Action items & next steps (10m)

Attachments: MAP_template_v1.pdf (editable), evaluation-checklist.xlsx (worksheet for metrics). I'll include a calendar hold once you confirm which slot works and who will attend from Acme. Zoom link and ICS attached in follow-up.

Internal note: Lauren/Vivek — please review the evaluation checklist before we lock the slot; I'd like to propose Marissa as the evaluation lead from our side.

Thanks,
Connor
